case: timetz[] file consumers preserve explicit offsets across a TimeZone change
contract: The transaction fetches timetz[] under America/New_York with explicit offsets including +15:59 and -15:59, fractional seconds and SQL NULL.
After changing TimeZone to UTC, typed rebinding preserves PostgreSQL array_to_json and array_send values.
JSON/CSV exports preserve BookiE's array text; SQL replay restores the native timetz[] type, JSON and wire bytes while preserving a sibling row.
The XLSX export remains a string cell without a formula.

focused_test.command: rtk proxy env BOOKIEE_XLSX_REIMPORT_ARTIFACT=<absolute-evidence-dir>/source.xlsx cargo test --offline --locked -p tablepro-driver-postgres --test integration array_contract::value_contract_timetz_array_file_exports_preserve_offsets_for_calc_reimport -- --ignored --exact --test-threads=1

remaining: Other temporal-array types, session/consumer combinations and the broader B3 matrix remain open.
